| marked | 12.0.2 | MIT (`marked-LICENSE.md`) |
| vega | 5.30.0 | BSD-3-Clause (`vega-LICENSE`) |
| vega-lite | 5.21.0 | BSD-3-Clause (`vega-lite-LICENSE`) |
| vega-embed | 6.26.0 | BSD-3-Clause (`vega-embed-LICENSE`) |
| plotly.js (dist-min) | 2.35.2 | MIT (`plotly-LICENSE`) |
| KaTeX | 0.16.11 | MIT (`../katex/LICENSE`) |
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (`../leaflet/LICENSE`) |
| highlight.js | 11.10.0 | BSD-3-Clause (`../hljs/LICENSE`) |
